components.title: macOS launchd integration for weekly notifications
components.description: Spec section 13 macOS LaunchAgent: praxis install-weekly creates ~/Library/LaunchAgents/co.praxis.weekly.plist that fires praxis week --notify on schedule; praxis uninstall-weekly removes it; osascript-based notification with trajectory label in body; non-macOS prints systemd/Task Scheduler snippet.
